rules.description: [dotfiles] tmux prefix in the browser: Home (ArkButton thumb) / fn+Left / caps_lock, then 1-9 n p c x w s f : [ v o l r z u ? & — plus a copy-mode layer over caret browsing. Chrome & Brave only.
[dotfiles] caps_lock -> home (global) — gives the MacBook built-in keyboard a real Home key for the tmux prefix. ArkButton has no caps_lock, so this is a no-op there.
